findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/bundle-recover.js::partial cleanup re-reported as noop-already-present in removewritten
findings.title: partial cleanup re-reported as noop-already-present in removeWritten
findings.action: Remove the restored ledger first so a partial cleanup still reads as absent on the next recovery.
findings.disposition_rationale: removeWritten now deletes files in write order, ledger first (commit 90e88a8b); if only a later removal fails, the next recovery sees no ledger and re-restores.

occurrences.title: partial cleanup re-reported as noop-already-present in removeWritten

findings.title: non-atomic restored ledger write in reconstructProjection
findings.action: Publish the snapshot bytes with atomicWriteSingleValueFile.
findings.disposition_rationale: The ledger is now written via atomicWriteSingleValueFile (tmp then rename), same bytes, so unlocked readers never see a torn file (commit 90e88a8b).

occurrences.title: non-atomic restored ledger write in reconstructProjection

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/bundle-recover.js::post-refusal rmdir can remove another writer's empty run dir in bundlerecover
findings.title: post-refusal rmdir can remove another writer's empty run dir in bundleRecover
findings.action: Only remove a run dir this recovery created.
findings.disposition_rationale: restoreUnderLedgerLock now returns createdRunDir and bundleRecover only rmdirs when it is true; covered by a new test that a pre-existing empty run dir survives a failed restore.

occurrences.title: post-refusal rmdir can remove another writer's empty run dir in bundleRecover

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/bundle-recover.js::unlocked dry-run read races a real restore in bundlerecover
findings.title: unlocked dry-run read races a real restore in bundleRecover
findings.action: No change: keep --dry-run an unlocked, read-only point-in-time preview, as the spec requires.
findings.disposition_rationale: The spec keeps --dry-run unlocked and read-only on purpose; its verdict is a point-in-time preview and the code comment already says it reads without the lock.

occurrences.title: unlocked dry-run read races a real restore in bundleRecover

findings.finding_id: plugin/skills/faff/bin/lib/bundle-recover.js::enoent retry catch broader than its trigger in restoreunderledgerlock
findings.title: ENOENT retry catch broader than its trigger in restoreUnderLedgerLock
findings.action: No change: only the lock acquire can raise ENOENT to the retry.
findings.disposition_rationale: Inside attempt(), mkdir errors are returned as failed, every reconstructProjection throw (copyFileSync included) is caught and returned as failed, and the ledger read swallows ENOENT; only the lock acquire can surface ENOENT to the retry.

occurrences.title: ENOENT retry catch broader than its trigger in restoreUnderLedgerLock
